description.value: The Lodge is a recently renovated hotel within the Skeena Landing commercial complex, situated at the junction of Highway 16 and Highway 37 just minutes from downtown Terrace. It occupies a 20+ acre mixed-use property that includes retail, restaurant, and office tenants, giving guests walkable access to shops and an on-site Indian restaurant. The property advertises a private, quiet setting alongside modern comforts including fireplaces and patios in select rooms.
